quotes: Very friendly and welcoming staff.

themes.label: Cocktails and bar
themes.text: Cocktails, the bar and drink selection are widely praised, including the tequila sundae and cheap takeout drinks, though one reviewer found the cocktails weak.
quotes: Best tequila cocktail I've ever had - tequila sundae
They just started margaritas and cocktails for takeout and they are cheap and delicious

themes.label: Food quality and dishes
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious, naming duck confit, varenyky and steak au poivre, but two found dishes mediocre or underwhelming.
quotes: Varenyky are delicious and so was borsch.
the food is mediocre at best

themes.label: Interior and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the beautiful, clean, elegant decor and relaxed, lively vibe, even the one who disliked the food and service.
quotes: Delicious food in a beautiful interior.
Place was pretty lively, music was nice, you could actually have a conversation.

themes.label: Reasonable prices
themes.text: Reviewers describe wine, drinks and meals as reasonably priced or cheap, including during takeout.
quotes: Wine very reasonably priced for NYC.

themes.label: Large portions, good value
themes.text: Many reviewers say portions are big, with leftovers or leaving full, and often feel this makes the high prices worthwhile.
quotes: I thought it was a bit pricey until I saw the portions they give you. It's well worth the money.
A little pricey, but you get a lot of food.

themes.label: Prices too high
themes.text: Several reviewers call the restaurant pricey or overpriced, with some saying the food does not justify the cost.
quotes: Good but not 50 dollars minimum a plate good.
If I'm paying $40 and better for a meal (and that's just fish or shrimp), it should be flawless.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, fast service, but a few report bad service, arguing staff or poor crowd control at the front desk.
quotes: Excellent service and great food
Service was bad and food is overpriced!

themes.label: Food quality and freshness
themes.text: Many call the seafood delicious and fresh, while others found it stale, unseasoned, overcooked or not what it used to be.
quotes: Great place for fresh fish. Hands down the best I would say in USA!
Dinner was OK. Food not what it used to be.

themes.label: Crowding and waits
themes.text: A few reviewers found the restaurant overcrowded and poorly organized, with waits and heat.
quotes: Food was good but I think a little Air conditioning will of made it SO much better

themes.label: Drinks and cocktails
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise the drinks and cocktails as delicious, great or amazing, though one reviewer found the bartender's drink disappointing.
quotes: The oysters are amazing and there drink mix are wonderful
The cocktails are excellent and the food is great.

themes.label: Crowds and long waits
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the place as too crowded, with long waits for food or seating, and some report line-cutting and unclear number calls.
quotes: Avoid on weekends, too crowded.
The food is ok just a long wait

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find prices decent and portions large, while others say the food became overpriced with small portions.
quotes: There snow crab legs are great and they give you a big portion
Food is too expensive and portions are small.

themes.label: Seafood dishes quality
themes.text: Most praise dishes like crab legs, lobster tails and fried fish, but others call the food mediocre, flavorless or worse than before.
quotes: Love ,love their stuffed lobster tails.
The fish doesn't have any flavor.

themes.label: Outdoor seating and view
themes.text: Reviewers like the outdoor seating, water and marina views, and the relaxed tiki bar setting.
quotes: Delicious food and drinks and lots of outdoor seating!
eating outside next to the water

themes.label: Hot dog quality
themes.text: Many call the hot dogs the best and a must-try, while others find them salty, nothing special or no better than fast food.
quotes: After 100 years this place still has the best hot dogs in New York.
Cheap and cheerful and you have to go to this Coney Island institution but the hotdogs are way too salty

themes.label: Service and staff attitude
themes.text: Some praise good, quick service, while others report rude, unfriendly staff or very slow service.
quotes: Crowded but very quick customer service
The rudest staff I've ever met.

themes.label: Waits and long lines
themes.text: Reviewers mention long waits to order and crowded lines, though a few say the many registers move people through quickly.
quotes: WAITED. TO. LONG. TO. GET. A HOT. DOG. !!!!
Many registers so if you encounter a line no need to panic as you'll get through quickly.

themes.label: Price for value
themes.text: Several reviewers feel the food is pricey for what it is, though a couple describe prices as cheap or low.
quotes: Mediocre food. Not worth the price.
A little pricey but it's Nathan's. At Coney Island.

themes.label: Fries and sides
themes.text: Fries, clams, chowder and frog legs are frequently praised, though one reviewer found the fries overcooked and another found them cold inside.
quotes: Love the fries ,clam chowder n clams
fries were overly cooked you can taste nothjng by the old.oil they cooked it in.

themes.label: Crowds and long lines
themes.text: Reviewers say the place gets packed and ordering lines are long, though some note lines move at a fair pace and weekdays are quieter.
quotes: Good seafood at a good price expect long lines to order it can get crowded.
Almost two hours on line and then we go In make our order

themes.label: Water views and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers praise the waterfront view, the relaxed vibe and the indoor and outdoor seating.
quotes: Great place to take in the beautiful views of the Throggs Neck Bridge and water.
Some best freshest seafood and incredible view

themes.label: Shrimp and fried seafood
themes.text: Many love the shrimp and fried seafood, while others found it flavorless, dry, or with breading falling off.
quotes: Love their shrimp! Been coming here for years, even before renovation.
The breading was falling off the shrimp and the fries were soggy.

themes.label: Cash only payment
themes.text: Several reviewers point out the restaurant takes only cash, with an ATM on site, and some wish this would change.
quotes: Oh and this is still a CASH ONLY place (wish they would change that).
Minus one star because it's cash only, although there is an ATM on site.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find good prices and portions, especially at the raw bar, while others call it overpriced or say portions are too small.
quotes: Not enough food for your money.
Good food, great portion for the money.

themes.label: Sicilian square pizza
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the square Sicilian pizza, with its sauce on top and fluffy dough, as the best in Brooklyn, though a few found it undercooked or merely fine.
quotes: Few pizze go down quite as easily as their signature Sicilian (sauce on top, fluffy dough... It's a cloud made of pizza).
The square pie was tasty, but undercooked, very doughy...making it feel like it just sits at the bottom of your stomach.

themes.label: Spumoni dessert
themes.text: Reviewers regularly call the spumoni excellent and a must-try dessert, often the best they have had.
quotes: it was my first time trying spumoni. I'm officially hooked. Definitely worth the wait.
The spumoni next door is excellent as well.

themes.label: Crowds and parking
themes.text: Reviewers say the place gets packed and parking can be hard, though some note multiple windows, plenty of seating and a free lot.
quotes: Parking can be a hassle on weekends. I normally park a block away on Avenue V when the lot is full.
Recommended place but be aware that it's almost always packed

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Most describe service as fast, nice or improving, while one reviewer said the waiter forgot the order and another called it just okay.
quotes: I've been going there for years and the service just gets better!
Waiter just forgetting what you ordered but after you recall him he remember.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find it fairly priced with big portions and good value, while others say prices have risen and it is expensive.
quotes: Prices are really getting out of hand, $9.75 for a meatball (3 meatballs) parm hero.
Great value for pie and quickest slice in the boro

themes.label: Friendly, helpful staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff and good customer service, though a few describe rude, annoyed or dishonest employees.
quotes: Staff was very sweet and thankful for the frontline.
Staff needs to be more friendly, they seemed upset and annoyed

themes.label: Fresh, tasty donuts
themes.text: Many reviewers say the donuts are fresh, delicious and melt in the mouth, with the glazed ones singled out.
quotes: Fresh baked Glazed Doughnuts are like heaven in your mouth!
Donuts were very fresh and tasty.

themes.label: Slow lines and waits
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits, with online orders no faster than walk-ins, though some find the line short or worth it.
quotes: The regular line moves faster than ordering online!
it was only 7 of us in line and i had to wait for 45 minutes

themes.label: Cleanliness of the store
themes.text: Reviewers describe the store as clean and neat, and some note good social distancing.
quotes: It is very clean, the employees are friendly and the social distancing is well practiced.
The store was clean and shiny.

themes.label: Online and delivery order problems
themes.text: Several customers say online or delivery orders arrived missing, late or never, and that orders cannot be cancelled online.
quotes: Order for delivery my order never arrived I called to they told me my order left the store at 6:12
YOU CAN NOT CANCEL YOUR ORDER ONLINE. THERE IS NO OPTION FOR THAT.

themes.label: Long waits and lines
themes.text: Many reviewers describe long, slow lines, especially on weekends, but most say the food is worth the wait; a few call the service slow or disorganized.
quotes: Spent one hour plus on the line to get food today, Sunday, September 2nd.
Long lines but the food was worth the wait.

themes.label: Doubles quality
themes.text: Doubles are repeatedly called the best, with praise for the sauces and chutney, though one reviewer says they are no longer as good as before.
quotes: The best doubles I've tasted in a long time their cucumber chutney is wow
The only disappointment is that the doubles is no longer good like it was a few years ago.

themes.label: Staff friendliness and service
themes.text: Some reviewers found staff rude or unhelpful, while others praised friendly, helpful and efficient service.
quotes: They behave as though they are doing you a favor and not that you are paying your money.
The staff is friendly and helpful and the shop itself is very clean.

themes.label: Authentic Trinidadian food
themes.text: Reviewers praise the food as authentic, fresh and reminiscent of home, with several traveling from Philly or Long Island for it.
quotes: Great authentic Trinidadian Curry...all the comforts of home
Love this place best Trini Food in New York worth the drive from Long Island .

themes.label: Cleanliness and seating
themes.text: Reviewers describe the shop as clean and nicely kept, though weekend evening seating and parking are limited.
quotes: Clean establishment well lit with delicious food prepared fresh while you wait.
there aren't many available seats in the evening on weekends, we usually just take it home.

themes.label: Birria tacos quality
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the birria tacos among the best they have had, praising flavor, tender meat and texture.
quotes: Tacos have an outer crispy layer and a soft layer. Meat is well seasoned and tender.
the meat is really tender and the consome really brings the dish together.

themes.label: Consomé broth
themes.text: The consomé is praised as flavorful and a must-get for dipping tacos, with some saying it rivals the tacos.
quotes: You gotta get the consume and dip the tacos in that lovely broth. Magic right there.
Consome arguably better than taco, but that's splitting hairs.

themes.label: Long lines, worth waiting
themes.text: Many describe long lines and waits of 40 minutes or an hour, but nearly all say the food justified it.
quotes: I literally waited for 40 mins for this, it was totally worth the wait.
The only bad thing about this taco spot is that there's always a wait

themes.label: Low prices, good value
themes.text: Reviewers find the food cheap or fairly priced for the quality and portions.
quotes: Between my husband , child & I we spend 35$ for 9 tacos 1 soup & 2 sodas .
It's also insanely cheap. Staff is also very kind.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most describe friendly, fast staff and a clean truck, though one reviewer found a worker curt about splitting the consomé.
quotes: Place is clean. And the owner and workers are friendly.
The guy aggressively said "no, and to move on with the order".

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Early reviewers praised delicious food, but most later reviewers found it bland, burnt, spoiled, cold or otherwise bad, and some reported hair or bugs.
quotes: Delicious food. Excellent friendly service. Greatest value.
The food is bland and no seasonings at all! Please learn to season your food before opening a restaurant!

themes.label: Rude owner and staff
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the owner and staff as rude or dismissive, though early reviews called the service friendly and courteous.
quotes: Simply terrible service, owner, Svitlana Flom, take some classes and educate themselves on the proper way to treat people.
the owner/manger whoever she was is extremely rude. With a take it or leave it attitude.

themes.label: Discrimination claims
themes.text: Several reviewers say they were turned away, ignored or threatened with police because of their skin color or ethnicity.
quotes: The owner of the restaurant threatening to call the cop on me because I was non-white
I was told I couldn't eat here because of my skin color.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Later reviewers call the food overpriced for its portion size and quality, while one early reviewer found it good value.
quotes: food was below average and too expensive for the portion size and taste
Overpriced terribly burnt food and rude staff backed up by the owner who is even worse.

themes.label: Cleanliness and atmosphere
themes.text: Early reviewers liked the cosy, pleasant room, but later ones described a dirty restaurant, filthy bathroom or drab atmosphere.
quotes: Pleasant atmosphere. Fast and courteous cervice.
The restaurant was very dirty with food and grime on the floor and tables.

themes.label: Fresh, tasty food
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the food as fresh, delicious and high quality, though one reviewer said quality dropped and another found the fried fish mostly breading.
quotes: the food they serve is so fresh and tasty
The food is always fresh and delicious and will recommend it to others

themes.label: Reasonable prices
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the prices reasonable, affordable or a good deal.
quotes: Very good, clean and reasonable prices! Highly recommend!
The food is fresh and fast. The price is very reasonable. We will come again!

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many praise friendly, attentive service, but a few describe a rude phone worker, a cashier refusing pennies, and an order dispute with no credit.
quotes: Service is very good and attentive.
She hung up on me, I ordered 2 simple things.

themes.label: Delivery and speed
themes.text: Most say delivery and food arrive fast and on time, but one reviewer reported a very slow delivery and another had trouble with delivery change.
quotes: The food was delivered within the prescribed time, it was fresh and great.

themes.label: Cleanliness
themes.text: Several reviewers call the food and place clean, but one saw a dropped eggroll put back with the cooked ones.
quotes: The food is very tasty. Very clean!
a cooked eggroll was dropped on the floor

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, friendly, quick waiters and hosts, though a few report rude staff, slow food, or a very slow check.
quotes: Rude waiters, overpriced and mediocre seafood.not worth the trip

themes.label: Food quality and freshness
themes.text: Reviewers frequently call the seafood fresh and delicious, praising lobster rolls, crab legs, shrimp and fish, though a few found it ordinary.
quotes: People say fish is fish, not at Lobster House. The fish is cooked to perfection
We travel from Long Island for the BEST seafood...delicious & FRESH!

themes.label: Large portions and freebies
themes.text: Diners describe huge portions plus complimentary starters, desserts and amaretto, though one reviewer found a broiled platter skimpy for its price.
quotes: Stuffed our faces food was amazing they really feed you here
We also got a complimentary salad, dessert, and after dinner aperitif. It was definitely amaretto.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices fair for the portions, while others call the restaurant pricey or overpriced, citing a lobster surcharge and holiday increases.
quotes: It's a bit pricey but the portions and taste match that price.
Lobster was good but the restaurant added a $5lb surcharge.

themes.label: Atmosphere and outdoor view
themes.text: Many enjoy the waterside deck, sunset view and boat-themed decor, but one found it too loud and another thought it looked worn.
quotes: sit out back on a warm day for the westward facing sunset view!
It was very loud couldn't talk comfortably gave me a headache, we had to leave

themes.label: Meal taste and recipes
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the meals as delicious, creative and easy to follow, and some say the kits taught them new dishes.
quotes: The food is top quality, flavorful, healthy & inventive. The recipes are easy to make.

themes.label: Spoiled or poor ingredients
themes.text: Many reviewers received moldy, rotten, wilted or buggy produce and spoiled meat, which cost them trust and meals.
quotes: the last 2 orders came with moldy green beans and chicken that felt like rubber
Another recipe had sun dried tomatoes that were rotten, and a third recipe had a peach that was rotten.

themes.label: Missing or wrong ingredients
themes.text: Reviewers report boxes lacking main ingredients such as meat or garlic, or containing the wrong item, though some received prompt credits.
quotes: One meal was made with salmon and the salmon was missing, the chicken receipe was missing the chicken
I got sent the wrong ingredient for a cabbage slaw (bag of iceberg lettuce instead).

themes.label: Late or poor delivery
themes.text: Reviewers complain of boxes arriving a day late or very late at night, plus courier problems, though one says orders came on time.
quotes: I ended up canceling my subscription after 2 weeks because both weeks the box arrived a day late.
I am deactivating my account due to poor delivery service through Fed Ex.

themes.label: Customer service
themes.text: Some found support kind and quick to credit or refund, while others could not reach anyone or were refused refunds.
quotes: I tried numerous times to call customer service each time I never reached a rep and was disconnected.
Customer service has been great for this company thus far!

themes.label: Slow service and waits
themes.text: Many reviewers describe long waits, especially at the drive-through, with some reporting 20 to 45 minutes, though a few say service was fast.
quotes: Long wait at drive through took over 20 minutes. Tightest driveway ever!! Trucks will curb your rims for sure.
They take forever at this place. The employees work at their own pace.

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Many reviewers found staff friendly and pleasant, while others reported rude, unhappy or unprofessional employees.
quotes: I'm always happy to come here. Everyone is friendly and the food is good.
the gentleman that was taking my order was very rude and unprofessional.

themes.label: Cleanliness of dining area
themes.text: Some reviewers praise a clean dining area and bathrooms, while others found dirty tables, carpet and no clean trays.
quotes: The tables and carpet were dirty. Food cold
Clean eating area. If someone spilled it someone is there to clean it.

themes.label: Order accuracy and training
themes.text: Several reviewers say orders are often wrong and staff need better training, though one says their order is always right.
quotes: These people never gets your order right. They need to tran they employees better.
No reason to mess up orders especially when it isn't a rush hour.

themes.label: Food quality and value
themes.text: Reviewers often call the food fresh, hot and good, and like the 4 for 4 deal and affordable prices, though some mention cold food or salty fries.
quotes: the food there it's hot and fresh all the time
Great food at affordable prices

themes.label: Long waits
themes.text: Many reviewers say food takes a long time, sometimes over an hour, though some feel the food is worth waiting for.
quotes: Food at this place is absolutely delicious but the wait time is too long.
The only thing is the wait, but the food is fresh and good so u have to expect a wait.

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the fish, shrimp, salmon, mac and cheese and soul food, though a few found dishes bland, salty or undercooked.
quotes: If you are a seafood lover you're in heaven.
Shrimp and salmon alfredo is amazing!! They have great portions.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Reviewers disagree: some find staff friendly and quick, while many describe rude attitudes, disorganization and mishandled orders.
quotes: The staff is rude..but the food makes up for their ways.
Service was quick, cashier was friendly, order was correct, food tasted good.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some see low prices and good lunch portions, while others report price increases and extra charges that feel expensive.
quotes: A little expensive for simple fish. Other fish stores or restaurants have similar taste for a lot less
Definitely wonderful place and authentic food, and low prices.

themes.label: Roast beef sandwiches
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the roast beef sandwich, often with cheese, the best around and the main reason to visit.
quotes: Best Roast Beef with cheese hands down, plus amazing lemonade and corn fritters
The most incredible roast beef sandwich. Razor thin sliced roast beef give it a cotton candy like texture that just bites through with ease

themes.label: Cheese fries and sides
themes.text: Cheese fries are praised as among the best, along with lemonade and milkshakes, though one reviewer found the house fries awful and another found fries tasteless.
quotes: Great Roast Beef Sandwiches. But best of all, the CHEESE FRIES. THE BEST.
The house fries are really chips they were horrible. Never getting that again.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some call prices reasonable or good for a budget, while others find it expensive or overpriced, and one says prices became inflated.
quotes: Decent food, not expensive, good place for a bite on a budget
Great food but the prices became waaaay too inflated

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Reviewers split on staff, with some finding them friendly and fast and others describing discourteous or nasty service.
quotes: The service is fast and the staff is very friendly.
The most discourteous staff in all of Brooklyn - no business or customer service sense

themes.label: Crowds and waiting
themes.text: The place gets crowded, noisy and slow at times, though one reviewer says the long wait is worth it.
quotes: The wait can be long but perfection takes time. The wait is totally worth it!
it gets very crowded and at times a little insane and wait times tend to be long

themes.label: Retro 60s design
themes.text: Reviewers love the preserved mid-century terminal, the retro decor and the nostalgic feel of stepping back in time.
quotes: OMG, a perfect restoration to teleport you back to the 60's
Spectacular design, mind-blowing attention to detail, a master-class in branding.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Some guests praise friendly, helpful staff, while others report rude or untrained front desk staff and impersonal kiosk check-in.
quotes: Extremely rude front staff.....need to step up your game!! What about some customer service!
First class customer service!

themes.label: Rooms and beds
themes.text: Rooms are often called quiet and comfortable with good beds, but some find them small, dirty or lacking amenities.
quotes: The room had a very comfortable bed and it was quite.
got to our room to discover an unflushed toilet and a dirty washcloth in the shower.

themes.label: Food and drink prices
themes.text: Several reviewers find food and drinks pricey, though some praise the food quality and cocktails.
quotes: Cool trip back in time except for the 5 dollar cup of coffee
Food is a little pricey, but that's to be expected.

themes.label: Rooftop pool and bars
themes.text: Guests enjoy the rooftop pool and bar views and the cocktails in the Constellation plane lounge.
quotes: Great, unique view; and much less expensive than other rooftops around the city
heated rooftop pool was still open and worthy of a dip even when it's 35f outside

themes.label: Pizza taste and quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the pizza as delicious, with a crisp NY-style crust and fresh toppings, though a few found it bland, burnt or not good.
quotes: Great crispy thin crust pizza, as good as NYC pizza is, Ive had some bad pizza experiences, but this place was great
Foldable crust with the edge crisp that has to snap to fold. It was perfect.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff and a kind owner, with excellent service, though one reviewer found the staff disrespectful.
quotes: The pizza was delicious and the staff is very friendly!
Disrespectful staff.hes mad at the world.Not worth a visit

themes.label: Cheap slice deals
themes.text: Reviewers like the low prices, especially the two slices and a soda for about five dollars deal.
quotes: 2 regular slices and a soda for 5 bucks can't be beat.
They have an offer of 2 pieces of pizza plus a soda ($ 5).

themes.label: Tiny space
themes.text: The shop is described as very small with few seats, suiting takeaway or a quick slice; one reviewer disliked this, another found it homey.
quotes: It's a small place though more suitable for takeaways
There are only 4 or so chairs.
